description.text: General Information Programs are divided by foundational, intermediate and advanced classes. Students who successfully completed the study will be conferred relative certificates of University of Jinan. Courses Provided • Obligatory Courses: Basic Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Conversation, Reading, Composition, etc. • Optional Courses: Ancient Chinese Language, Contemporary Chinese, Professional Chinese, Chinese Classics, Philosophy, History of Chinese Culture, Chinese Calligraphy, Martial Arts, Chinese Traditional Handcraft, etc. • Lessons can also be decided according to specific needs of the students. Teaching Arrangements • Students will study 3 hours every day from Monday to Friday. • Term trips will be arranged to relative historical and cultural sites. Characteristic and Advantage Student tutors (majoring in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language) will be arranged to help language learners with their Chinese language study. duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Language Enhancement Program at Weifang University is a 3 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 41 USD/per week ￥ 300 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1. application form 2. personal resume 3. scanned copy of passport 4. graduation certificate 5. certification of employment (if employed) and certificate of non-criminal records.

requirements.text: 1. The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.
